data.one_liner: Flutter widgets and helpers to convert dates into humanized fuzzy timestamps like '15 minutes ago'.
data.what_it_does: Converts DateTime instances into human-readable fuzzy text representations. Provides Flutter widgets like Timeago and TimerRefresh to automatically display and update relative time strings.
use_when: You want to display relative timestamps such as 'an hour ago' in a Flutter app.
You need automatic timer refreshing for relative timestamps in UI widgets.
avoid_when: You need complex calendar calculations or internationalized date formatting outside of fuzzy time strings.
strengths: Simple API with built-in Flutter widgets for auto-refreshing timestamps.
Supports custom messages and multiple locales.
weaknesses: Only includes English and Spanish messages by default; additional locales must be registered manually.
Deliberately limited scope to keep maintenance minimal.
